_what: The models this computer serves for its person's Trillion, asked by tool:ask-a-model (computer/local-models.mjs, run by computer/mac-tools.mjs). A conversation ({ messages }) goes to the first `chat` row whose server answers, in the OpenAI chat-completions shape (Ollama serves it; keep_alive is how long the server keeps the model loaded after a call, so the next one does not wait for it to load); a yes-or-no question about some words ({ state, questions }) goes to the first `classify` row that answers: a small classifier taking { state, questions } and answering probabilities, or, for a row whose `ask` is "chat", a chat model asked each question with the row's `prompt` and its probability of answering yes read from its own word probabilities (local-models.mjs yesShare). A server that is not running is skipped; none answering is said in words, and Trillion tries its next route. Nothing leaves this computer but the answer. The `chat`, `classify`, `offer`, `jobs` and `wired` tables are read from tools/models-on-this-computer/read-data/models-on-this-computer.json, the one copy of them, into this settings object under those names; a new local server or model is a row there. `server` is the local model server this Mac uses (Ollama): `models` lists what it has, `pull` gets a model by its name (an Ollama name, or a Hugging Face model as hf.co/<repo>:<quantisation>), and `install` is how it is put on this Mac when it is missing (the helper row of that name in computer/helper-runtimes.json: a copy the person installed is used, otherwise fetched and receipted, then opened). `offer` are the models offered for this Mac by tool:get-free-models (computer/local-models.mjs modelsForThisMac): each with the job it does, how much memory it needs to run well (min_memory_gb) and its download size; a model fits when the Mac has that memory and the size plus `disk_spare_gb` free. Its `model` names match the `chat` and `classify` rows, so a model got here answers at once.

words.none: No model on this computer answered in time.
words.too_big: This Mac does not have the memory or free space for it.
words.not_offered: That model is not one offered for this Mac.
words.no_server: The model server could not be put on this Mac. Download it from ollama.com, open it, and ask again.
words.needs_input: Give messages (a conversation) or state and questions (a question about some words).
